	`zone_id` text NOT NULL,
	`status` text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE `mailboxes` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`user_id` text NOT NULL,
	`domain_id` text NOT NULL,
	`local_part` text NOT NULL,
	`display_name` text,
	`created_at` integer NOT NULL,

);

CREATE TABLE `message_bodies` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`message_id` text NOT NULL,
	`text_body` text,
	`html_body` text,
	`raw_r2_key` text,
	FOREIGN KEY (`message_id`) REFERENCES `messages`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX `message_bodies_message_id_unique` ON `message_bodies` (`message_id`);

CREATE TABLE `messages` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`user_id` text NOT NULL,
	`mailbox_id` text,
	`direction` text NOT NULL,
	`provider_message_id` text,
	`from_addr` text NOT NULL,
	`to_addr` text NOT NULL,
	`subject` text,
	`snippet` text,
	`status` text DEFAULT 'received' NOT NULL,
	`thread_id` text,
	`created_at` integer NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade,
	FOREIGN KEY (`mailbox_id`) REFERENCES `mailboxes`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE set null
);
CREATE INDEX `messages_user_created_idx` ON `messages` (`user_id`,`created_at`);
CREATE INDEX `messages_mailbox_idx` ON `messages` (`mailbox_id`);

CREATE TABLE `outbound_jobs` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`user_id` text NOT NULL,
	`message_id` text,
	`status` text DEFAULT 'queued' NOT NULL,
	`payload` text NOT NULL,
	`error` text,
	`created_at` integer NOT NULL,
	`updated_at` integer NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade,
	FOREIGN KEY (`message_id`) REFERENCES `messages`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE set null
);

CREATE TABLE `routing_rules` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`user_id` text NOT NULL,
	`domain_id` text NOT NULL,
	`pattern` text NOT NULL,
	`mailbox_id` text,
	`action` text DEFAULT 'store' NOT NULL,
	`forward_to` text,
	`priority` integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
	`created_at` integer NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade,
	FOREIGN KEY (`domain_id`) REFERENCES `domains`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade,
	FOREIGN KEY (`mailbox_id`) REFERENCES `mailboxes`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE set null
);

CREATE TABLE `sessions` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`user_id` text NOT NULL,
	`token_hash` text NOT NULL,
	`expires_at` integer NOT NULL,
	`created_at` integer NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX `sessions_token_hash_unique` ON `sessions` (`token_hash`);

CREATE TABLE `users` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`email` text NOT NULL,
	`password_hash` text NOT NULL,
	`name` text NOT NULL,
	`created_at` integer NOT NULL
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX `users_email_unique` ON `users` (`email`);

CREATE TABLE `webhook_deliveries` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`webhook_id` text NOT NULL,
	`event_type` text NOT NULL,
	`payload` text NOT NULL,
	`status` text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
	`attempts` integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
	`created_at` integer NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`webhook_id`) REFERENCES `webhooks`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade

CREATE TABLE `webhooks` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`user_id` text NOT NULL,
	`url` text NOT NULL,
	`secret` text NOT NULL,
	`events` text NOT NULL,
	`enabled` integer DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
	`created_at` integer NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade
